vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Mercedes LH/RH (left/right) = the vehicle's own left/right: LH = UK nearside (passenger side), RH = UK offside (driver side). Facelift from 2023: entries say pre-facelift or facelift where the source does. Rear bumpers, rear lamps and the tailgate are hatch (W177) parts as listed; no saloon (V177) rear-end numbers were recorded. Numbers were read from web-search result titles and extracts of the cited pages (eBay UK, globalparts.co.uk); page fetches were blocked by this session's network policy. Most listings are used breaker parts and no reliable new-part UK price was seen, so no prices were recorded. Bumpers, grilles, badges, headlamps, rear lamps, mirrors, wheels and cooling parts depend on trim (SE / Sport / AMG Line / Mercedes-AMG A 35), PTS parking sensors, lamp type (halogen / LED High Performance / MULTIBEAM LED), mirror equipment, engine or facelift, so they are marked variant and not auto-filled. Headlamps marked market 'unknown' were not stated to be RHD: check they are right-hand-drive (UK) lamps. globalparts.co.uk marks right-hand-drive stock with 'RHD' in the listing URL. Numbers were left out where listings conflicted on part type or side (A1778810100 / A1778810200 wing vs wing bracket; A2476906600 arch liner side; A0999061802 / A0999061902 mirror indicator side; A1777204000 front vs rear door card). Research stopped at the search budget (20 searches). Verify every number by VIN / datacard.
